title: Refuse a customer name made only of invisible characters, and fix the file-name over-refusals?
bluf: Narrowed: you ruled on 22 Oct (option a) that customer names refuse hidden and direction characters; that is built and deployed (HPSMPOC-178, PRs 187 and 189). Two leftovers are unruled. (1) HPSMPOC-324: a customer name of only U+200B (a character the ruling keeps) is still accepted, so a customer can have an invisible name. (2) HPSMPOC-257: the file-name check refuses some names Windows allows (LPT plus superscript 4, COM plus superscript 0). Recommend: refuse names that hold nothing visible, and for file names fold width and white space only (stops the over-refusals). Default if you do not tap: option C (change nothing), at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-324, HPSMPOC-257

options.label: Refuse invisible-only names; file names fold width/space only
options.detail: Settles 324 and 257. Agent builds with tests that fail first.

options.label: Refuse invisible-only names; leave file names as built
options.detail: Over-refusal of a few odd file names stays.

default_action: Option C: nothing changes until you tap.
